title: Restricted Standard-WOFOST Rate Evaluator Parameter and Input Inventory

phenology.name: IDSL
phenology.use: select temperature-only or temperature-plus-photoperiod vegetative development

assimilation_and_canopy.name: EFF
assimilation_and_canopy.use: initial light-use efficiency before CO2 response factor

assimilation_and_canopy.name: RELMF
assimilation_and_canopy.use: actual-trajectory attainable-yield multiplier; B1.10 actual PGASS always applies it

view_assembly_parameters_not_rate_equati.name: SSA
view_assembly_parameters_not_rate_equati.use: derive current total LAI from leaf cohorts plus stem area

view_assembly_parameters_not_rate_equati.name: SPA
view_assembly_parameters_not_rate_equati.use: derive current total LAI from leaf cohorts plus storage-organ area

structural_integrator_parameters_not_rat.name: SPAN
structural_integrator_parameters_not_rat.owner: F-WOF26 lifespan death during structural cohort update

structural_integrator_parameters_not_rat.name: DVSEND
structural_integrator_parameters_not_rat.owner: F-WOF26 structural DVS cap / lifecycle composition

required_scalars: WLV reconstructed as ordered sum of active LV cohorts
not_required: TSUM as a rate feedback input
anthesis flag because F-WOF26 owns first-crossing truncation
leaf cohort arrays themselves after WLV and LAI views have been assembled
leaf ages because lifespan death remains structural
nofd/atmin7 after the running minimum-temperature context has been prepared
root-depth or root-distribution state for admitted SWRD=1 rate equations

prepare_assimilation: TMNR from F-WOF26 candidate-local Tmin history

legacy_inputs_explicitly_excluded_from_r.name: KDIR
legacy_inputs_explicitly_excluded_from_r.reason: read by legacy read_wofost but no WOFOST rate equation in the scoped source reads the variable; ASSIM derives direct-beam extinction from KDIF and solar height

legacy_inputs_explicitly_excluded_from_r.name: TDWI
legacy_inputs_explicitly_excluded_from_r.reason: initialization only, not one-day rate evaluation

legacy_inputs_explicitly_excluded_from_r.name: SW_POTRELMF
legacy_inputs_explicitly_excluded_from_r.reason: controls potential shadow PGASS only; actual B1.10 PGASS always multiplies RELMF

legacy_inputs_explicitly_excluded_from_r.name: SW_HARV
legacy_inputs_explicitly_excluded_from_r.reason: lifecycle/harvest logic, not rate packet production

legacy_inputs_explicitly_excluded_from_r.name: AERATECRIT/SWWRTNONOX/IALPWET/WRTMAX
legacy_inputs_explicitly_excluded_from_r.reason: SWRD=3 and oxygen-sensitive root-growth branches excluded by admitted SWRD=1 profile

table_representation_contract.legacy: AFGEN consumes fixed macroptb alternating x,y arrays, clamps below/above range, and treats a decreasing x as an end-of-active-table sentinel
table_representation_contract.target: shared immutable compact piecewise-linear tables containing only active x,y knots
table_representation_contract.target_interpolation: clamp to first/last y outside active x range and linearly interpolate between bracketing knots
target_validation: strictly increasing x for adjacent active knots
no macroptb sentinel or unused tail stored in kernel parameter objects
table_representation_contract.reason: preserve AFGEN behavior without importing parser-era fixed array layout into the kernel

fail_closed_parameter_strengthening.legacy_gap: DLO and DLC are each accepted independently in [0,24] but IDSL=1 divides by DLO-DLC
TSUMEA and TSUMAM input ranges include zero although development equations divide by them
fail_closed_parameter_strengthening.target_rule: require the active phase denominator to be strictly positive; normally validate both >0 for the admitted standard parameter set

fail_closed_parameter_strengthening.legacy_gap: KDIF input range includes zero although ASSIM and critical-LAI death use it as a divisor or extinction denominator
fail_closed_parameter_strengthening.target_rule: require KDIF>0 for an active crop rate provider

fail_closed_parameter_strengthening.legacy_gap: CFRDM input range includes zero although PGASS conversion divides by CFRDM
CVR/CVS/CVL ranges include zero although CVF divides by them; CVO is guarded only by setting the storage term to zero when CVO<=0
fail_closed_parameter_strengthening.target_rule: require CVR>0, CVS>0, CVL>0 and require CVO>0 whenever evaluated FO>0; do not silently reinterpret nonzero storage allocation with CVO=0

fail_closed_parameter_strengthening.legacy_gap: Q10 range includes zero and the exponent may be negative
TOTASS/ASSIM divide by DSINBE and instantaneous SINB on active assimilation paths
fail_closed_parameter_strengthening.target_rule: validate explicit solar geometry as finite and denominator-safe whenever AMAX>0 and LAI>0; zero-assimilation short circuits may avoid unused denominator checks
